prompt: There is a bug report in ISSUE.md. Fix the code in this folder so the issue is resolved. Do not ask questions; make the fix.
final_response:
Implemented the fix in `pathglob.py`.

The new matcher:
- Matches the entire path case-sensitively.
- Supports `?`, `*`, and globstar `**` segment semantics.
- Supports `[abc]`, `[a-z]`, and `[!a-z]` classes without matching `/`.
- Supports backslash escaping.
- Uses only the standard library, with memoized matching to avoid redundant work.

Verified against 67+ semantic test cases, including nested `**`, trailing globstars, character classes, escapes, and whole-path matching.
